hero.description: Hosting Support Manager / DevOps Engineer at WPMU DEV. I lead distributed support engineers and stay hands-on with infrastructure, incidents, security, and automation.

whatIDo.title: Lead the team. Own the customer experience.
whatIDo.description: Manage distributed hosting support engineers, own critical escalations, and keep customers informed. Hire, mentor, review quality, and turn recurring problems into better processes.

whatIDo.title: Find the problem beneath the symptom.
whatIDo.description: Trace production issues across Linux, Nginx, PHP-FPM, and MySQL/MariaDB. Bring logs, observability, root cause analysis, and cross-team coordination together during incidents.

whatIDo.title: Make WordPress more reliable.
whatIDo.description: Troubleshoot architecture, multisite, WooCommerce, plugin conflicts, and migrations. Tune caching, DNS, CDN, and database behavior around the actual workload.

whatIDo.title: Investigate. Clean up. Harden.
whatIDo.description: Investigate compromised WordPress sites, review suspicious files, and support recovery. Address infection vectors, firewall rules, brute-force mitigation, and vulnerability remediation.

whatIDo.title: Turn repeated work into useful tools.
whatIDo.description: Build Bash scripts, Ansible workflows, REST API integrations, and internal tools. Use AI-assisted engineering to support investigation, documentation, and operational decisions.

highlights: Lead a distributed hosting support team, with responsibility for hiring, mentoring, quality, SOPs, and knowledge systems.
Own critical customer escalations and coordinate production incident response across teams.
Debug Linux, Nginx, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, WordPress, DNS, and caching issues; investigate compromised sites and support remediation.
Build automation and internal tooling with Ansible, Bash, REST APIs, and AI-assisted workflows.
experience.note: Current role shown; tenure includes earlier hosting support responsibilities.

highlights: Supported WooCommerce customers through plugin conflicts, PHP errors, and configuration issues; worked with developers on bug reports.
Built and maintained WordPress websites, configured hosting, and resolved plugin, PHP, and performance issues for clients.

community.description: Building a consistent space for developers, site owners, and new contributors to learn together. 100+ meetups and community events over the years.
Speaking and organizing involvement across WordCamps, including WordCamp Bhopal 2025 and the WordCamp Asia 2026 operations team.
Hands-on workshops introducing students to WordPress and open source.
Contributing to community programs and events that bring technical people together.
